glosses: present active imperfective participle of спать (spatʹ): sleeping

examples.text: Самый подходящий античный сюжет для этого - спящий Эндимион.

glosses: In a state of sleep; also, broadly, resting.

examples.text: I was asleep when you called.
How could you miss that? Were you asleep?
The reason they call it the American Dream is because you have to be asleep to believe it.

glosses: Having a numb or prickling sensation accompanied by a degree of unresponsiveness.

examples.text: My arm fell asleep. You know, like pins and needles.
Louisa sat in the car crying, until her foot fell asleep. She shook her foot violently, afraid the numbness would turn to frostbite.

glosses: спать (spatʹ) 的現在時主動態非完整體分詞：睡著
